definition: The Master Algorithm: How the Quest for the Ultimate Learning Machine Will Remake Our World is a book by Pedro Domingos released in 2015.
details: Domingos wrote the book in order to generate interest from people outside the field.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Think of it this way: The Master Algorithm: How the Quest for the Ultimate Learning Machine Will Remake Our World is a book by Pedro Domingos released in 2015. And here is the clever part: Domingos wrote the book in order to generate interest from people outside the field. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is The Master Algorithm — a small key that opens a big door.
